data.gender_notes: Osmundo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word ‘osmundus’, which derives from ‘os’, meaning wealth, and ‘mundus’, meaning protector. The name Osmundo honors Saint Osmund, a 11th-century English bishop known for his wealth and powerful protection. The name Osmundo carries the meaning “Wealthy protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Osmundo usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: עֹזְמוּנְדּוֹ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם עוזמונדו נובע מהשם הלועזי, שם גרמני-גאלי, שמשמעותו "השמר". בברית החדשה, אין שום שם שקשור לשם זה. השם עוזמונדו נפוץ בקרב האומות הגאליות, ואולי קשור לעם הקלטי. השם הוא שם נפוץ בחברת האצילים, וסמלה של חזקות, פורענות, והגנה.

in_greek.name: Οσμούνδος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Ὄσμουνδος, ὁ ὑποδηλωμένος φύλαξ, οὐκ ἔχων τρανόν Ὀσμόνα, ὄνομα ἡγουμένου, εἰ δὲ καὶ τὸν ἴδιον φύλαξιν ἀναδεικνύει. Ὁ φύλαξ, ὁ φρουρός, ὁ ἐπιμελητής, εἰς τὴν ἀπάντησιν τοῦ καλοῦντος. Ὁ φύλαξ, ὁ φρουρός, ὁ διακόνων, ὁ ἄρχων.

in_latin.name: Osmundus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Osmundus, a nomine Germanico-Gallorum, defendere significat. In Novo Testamento, nomen nullum est, quod cum nomine Osmundus coniunctum sit. Nomen Osmundus, in populo Gallorum, frequentissimum erat, et potissimum gentis Celtae coniunctum est. Nomen hoc, in nobilitate, et in gentibus, insignis erat, et significabat fortitudo, prosperitatem, et tutelam.

in_english.name: Osmundo
in_english.long_meaning: The name Osmundo originates from the Germanic-Gaelic name, meaning 'protector' or 'defender'. In the Bible, there is no name directly associated with Osmundo. The name is found in ancient Germanic and Gaelic cultures, and may be related to the Celtic people. Osmundo was a common name among the nobility and was often associated with strength, prosperity, and protection. It is a name that symbolizes a guardian and a protector, and is often associated with qualities of courage and bravery.

data.cultural_impact: The name Osmundo holds a profound cultural impact dating back to the Middle Ages in Europe. It was popularly given to children born into wealthy or influential families as a symbol of their status and protection. The name encapsulates the societal value of wealth and power, reflecting the aspirations of ancient Christian families during that era.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Saint Osmund, the namesake of Osmundo, played a significant role in the religious history of England. Born in the late 10th century, Osmund served as bishop of Salisbury and Sion, demonstrating the pious nature of the name. His devotion to Christ and service to the Catholic Church laid the foundation for the moral and spiritual legacy that the name holds today.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Osmundo represents the virtue of endurance and resilience in the face of adversity. Its etymology from the Latin 'osmundus' meaning 'fragrant' serves as a reminder that even in difficult times, one can still find the beauty and sweetness of life.

historical_references.reference: Osmund was a 10th-century Anglo-Saxon bishop and abbot, born in Northumbria. He became abbot of Bardney Abbey and was subsequently appointed bishop of Salisbury, serving in this capacity from 998 to 1009.

Osmund was also the name of a 12th-century French crusader mentioned in the 'Chanson d'Antioche', a French epic poem recounting the deeds of the First Crusade. Osmund joined the crusade in 1101 and was a close companion of Bohemond of Taranto.
